messages:
deploybot: Deploy blocked — environment=staging, commit=3f9a8c2, tag=release/v1.12.0-canary
deploybot: CI gate failed: 2 failing checks: security-scan, integration-e2e. CI link: https://ci.internal.build/3739
deploybot: Failing jobs: security-scan (policy: high-sev), e2e-flaky-queue (timeout at step 27)
sasha: @kevin @maria looking. I'm pulling security logs and re-running e2e. :eyes:
kevin: security report shows transitive dep `fast-serializer@2.1.0` flagged (CVE-2025-1234) as MEDIUM. It's from `lib-proto` -> `fast-serializer`.
maria: e2e logs: test `redirect-load-test` hung on socket, timed out after 12m. trace: https://ci.internal.build/artifacts/3739/e2e/redirect-load-test.log
jen: suggest trying quick rerun: `ci retry 3739 --jobs=e2e-flaky-queue,security-scan` then monitor. If security persists, need triage.
sasha: running rerun now:
```
ci retry 3739 --jobs=e2e-flaky-queue,security-scan
```
deploybot: Rerun queued by sasha — jobs started (security-scan, e2e-flaky-queue).
oncall-bot: FYI change window open until 21:00 UTC. If we need manual unblock, we can after approvals. :clock1:
kevin: if rerun fails, plan B: pin canary to previous release `release/v1.11.9` and continue smoke-only canary. We'll cut a hotfix PR to bump transitive dep in parallel.
maria: agrees — e2e is flaky, SRE can increase timeout as temporary mitigation. @andrew (eng-sre) can you weigh in?
andrew: can increase e2e timeout by 2x quickly, but that's masking the flake. I'll stand by to do it if needed. ETA ~10m.
sasha: update: security-scan still failing, same transitive hit. Escalating to research/infra. :warning:
kevin: I'll open hotfix PR to update lockfile and bump `lib-proto` deps. PR #4825, ETA 45m. If it's quick we can merge and re-run.
jen: approve moving forward with hotfix PR. If it's blocked, proceed with pin to v1.11.9 and leave rollback notes.
sasha: sounds good. I'll update the release notes/rollback doc and ping product. If we pin, steps:
```
1) deploybot pin --tag=release/v1.11.9 --env=staging
2) run smoke tests: ci run 3740 --jobs=smoke
3) if smoke ok, promote canary
```
deploybot: Noted. Will wait for explicit command to pin or proceed after PR merge. :white_check_mark:
maria: small nit — add a note to postmortem if we pin: "flaky e2e + transitive vuln blocked canary".
sasha: thanks everyone — will post another update in 20m. Keep monitoring CI link: https://ci.internal.build/3739
